source_report.roof_daylight_control: Closed opaque roof blackout fabric on curved guides above primary steel; fourteen independent roller sections per glazed ribbon with sealed overlaps, end gears and pole-operated drives. Clerestory rollers stowed with aligned guides, hem and catwalk-accessible chains. Roof lining stops outside glazing. Motion is structurally planned, not gameplay animated.

structural_planning.system: Five clear-span bowstring roof trusses with rolled chords, paired angle webs, riveted gussets and purlins
structural_planning.catwalks: Open bar grating on girders and column knee brackets; rear crosswalk on service-edge supports; tubular guards and toe boards
structural_planning.rigging: Seven longitudinal rows and fourteen cross battens, ending at Y=7.0 ahead of the stair; rear high carriers connect to roof ties above circulation headroom

stairs.position: Rear service band ahead of crosswalk; no deck over upper stair

exclusions: gameplay integration of door and blackout motion
